question: What signal should you give on approach when turning left at a roundabout?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 requires signalling left on approach when taking the first exit.

question: What signal should you give on approach when going straight ahead at a roundabout?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 says not to signal on approach when going straight ahead.

question: What signal should you give on approach when taking an exit to the right?
options: No signal until after you leave
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 tells you to signal right on approach for exits past straight ahead.

question: Why should you avoid signalling left too early when going straight ahead?
options: Waiting drivers may think you are taking the first exit and pull out
It is illegal on motorways only
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 avoids early left signals so waiting traffic is not misled.

question: How do you signal on approach when taking the first exit to the left?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 requires a left signal on approach for the first exit.

question: Which signal do you give on approach when going straight ahead (second exit)?
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 states not to signal on approach when going straight ahead.

question: If you signal right on approach, which exit are you telling others you want?
options: An exit to the right (past straight ahead)
The first exit on the left
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 uses a right approach signal for exits past straight ahead.

question: When should you start your approach signal for a roundabout?
options: In good time before reaching the give-way line
After you are already on the roundabout
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 and Rule 103 require early, clear approach signals.

question: What if the first exit is straight ahead and there is no left turn?
options: Treat it as straight ahead and do not signal on approach unless signs show left
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 matches your signal to the road layout and signs.

question: At a tiny mini-roundabout with little space, should you still signal your turn?
options: Yes, signal clearly in good time before entering
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 and 188 still require clear approach signals at mini-roundabouts.

question: Why is a right signal on approach helpful to drivers waiting at the left-hand entrance?
options: It warns them you are staying on the roundabout past their exit
It tells them to pull out in front of you
explain: Highway Code Rule 186 helps waiting drivers judge whether you will cross their path.
